blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed on 2026-10-01 at Ethereum block 26098749 for the authored canonical vault 0x0655977feb2f289a4ab78af67bab0d17aab84367. Runtime bytecode is an EIP-1167 clone fixed to implementation 0xd8063123bba3b480569244ae66bfe72b6c84b00d; its exact-match Yearn V3 source implements balance/allowance-based share transfers without holder blacklist, freeze, seizure, or privileged transfer hooks. asset() identifies crvUSD, totalDebt() is zero, and totalIdle() equals totalAssets(). Canonical share transfers have no local holder restriction, while upstream collateral restrictions remain inherited: the crvUSD cbBTC controller has positive debt, and cbBTC's current implementation exposes blacklist and pause with nonzero blacklister and pauser addresses. Those upstream controls are not a direct blacklist on scrvUSD or canonical crvUSD transfers. Curve also documents six bridged scrvUSD representations; this review does not establish their controls or transfer materiality and is limited to the authored Ethereum deployment.

branchApplicability.rationale: scrvUSD has no local borrower debt positions, collateral oracles, or liquidation branches, and its crvUSD parent retains its separate branch review. The Yearn V3 vault nevertheless computes a price-per-share from total assets and total supply to convert crvUSD into scrvUSD shares and redeem shares back to crvUSD, so its local NAV/exchange-rate accounting is a price-sensitive top-level authority.
